tasks.label: Read PC BOM from local PostgreSQL
args: SELECT p.model_code, ad.attribute_code, av.value_text, av.value_json::text FROM products p JOIN product_attribute_values av ON av.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_attribute_definitions ad ON ad.attribute_definition_id=av.attribute_definition_id JOIN product_types pt ON pt.product_type_id=ad.product_type_id AND pt.product_type_id=p.product_type_id WHERE p.model_code IN ('PBC-PC-GAME-002','PBC-PC-CREATOR-008') AND ad.attribute_code IN ('configuration_items','configuration_summary','bom_status') ORDER BY p.model_code, ad.attribute_code;
